paragraphs: R' Shmuel, brother of Rav. See the entry R' Shmuel, brother of R' Berekhiah.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has “brother of Rav,” while the target has “brother of Berekhiah.” אחויה/אחוי are rendered as brother-of relationships, not silently harmonized. Rav is full in the heading qualifier; the three abbreviated titles remain R'.
